source: Authenticated Cloudflare Pages project API and GraphQL pagesFunctionsInvocationsAdaptiveGroups; fresh production HTTP probes; deployed source and relevant tests

rootCauseEvidence.oldBehavior: The writer-activity request fetched and JSON-parsed the growing full receipt index and recovery report, then aggregated every receipt within the Pages request CPU budget.
rootCauseEvidence.currentBehavior: Background code publishes the compact WRITER_ACTIVITY.json summary; the request serves and validates that bounded summary, with an enforced 256 KiB streamed-read cap. It no longer aggregates the full ledger on each GUI poll.
rootCauseEvidence.confidence: Strong source-code and deployment-time correlation: final resource error is immediately after fix commit during rollout. Historical per-route logs were not available; do not represent route attribution as an exact log trace.
rootCauseEvidence.dailyEmailExplanation: The alert covers previous-day resource failures; its delivery does not establish a current fault. Daily request quota and per-invocation CPU limits are different measures.

validation.temporaryTail: Created for read-only diagnosis; websocket transport unavailable; session deleted after investigation. No per-route evidence claimed from it.

next: Treat this prior incident as resolved in current app status. Keep historical evidence on GitHub. Investigate only new post-fix exceededResources events; do not convert old daily-email totals into a persistent active fault.
